blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Road anomaly detection systems on autonomous vehicles must function reliably under degraded visual conditions including darkness, rain, and Harmattan dust haze. This paper benchmarks four object detection architectures, YOLOv8n, YOLOv12n, RT-DETR, and Faster R-CNN, under physically grounded lighting and weather degradation, and shows that uniform application of the SCI low-light enhancement network is actively harmful at dusk-level lighting (-16.1% to -30.7% mAP@50). We propose a lightweight, training-free luminance-adaptive router that selects between no enhancement, moderate SCI, and denoising plus strong SCI based on per-frame Rec. 601 luminance, recovering most of the dusk penalty while preserving low-light gains, and we validate the full pipeline on NVIDIA Jetson Nano edge hardware.
blocks.zh: 自主车辆上的道路异常探测系统必须在包括黑暗、雨和Harmattan尘雾在内的退化视觉条件下可靠运作。 本文将YOLOv8n,YOLOv12n,RT-DETR,以及更快的R-CNN四种物体检测架构作为基于物理的照明和天气退化的基准,并表明SCI低光增强网络的统一应用在黄昏灯光(16.1%至30.7% mAP@50)时具有积极危害性. 我们提出一个轻量级,无训练的润滑剂适应性路由器,在不增强,中度SCI,以及根据每帧Rec. 601的润滑剂进行除烟加强SCI之间选择,在保持低光度收益的同时回收大部分黄昏罚,我们验证NVIDIA Jetson Nano边缘硬件上的全管道.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Road-traffic crashes remain a severe public-health and economic burden in Nigeria: the Federal Road Safety Corps recorded 5,421 deaths from 9,570 crashes in 2024, a 7% rise over 2023 [1], and the WHO places Nigeria’s road-traffic death rate at 21.4 per 100,000, among the highest in Africa [2]. Poor infrastructure, potholes, eroded shoulders, poor lighting, weak signage, is repeatedly implicated, and the World Bank estimates a socio-economic cost of USD 29 billion in 2016, over 7% of GDP [3]. Automated pothole and speed-bump detection is a safety-critical perception task for advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS) and autonomous vehicles on West African roads, yet most detectors are trained and validated under favourable daytime illumination. Reliability degrades sharply under conditions routine in Nigeria: unlit night-time roads, the rainy season, and the Harmattan, a seasonal Saharan dust haze that can cut visibility to 200–500 m between November and February [6]. These conditions reduce contrast, add signal-dependent noise, and increase atmospheric scattering, weakening the features detectors depend on.
blocks.zh: 道路交通相撞事件仍然是尼日利亚严重的公共卫生和经济负担:联邦道路安全团记录了2024年9,570起相撞事故的5,421人死亡,比2023年上升了7% [1],而世卫组织则将尼日利亚道路交通相撞死亡率定为21.4%.,位列非洲最高[2]. 基础设施简陋,坑洞,肩部被侵蚀,照明不良,标志薄弱,屡被牵连,世界银行估计2016年的社会经济成本为290亿美元,超过GDP的7% [3]. 对西非公路上先进的司机辅助系统和自主车辆而言,自动坑洞和快推探测是安全的关键感知任务,但大多数探测器都是在有利的白天照明下得到训练和验证的。 在尼日利亚的例行条件下,可靠性急剧下降:夜行道、雨季和Harmattan是撒哈拉的季节性尘埃雾霾,在11月至2月期间能将能见度减少到200至500米[6]。 这些条件减少了对比,增加了依赖信号的噪音,并增加了大气散射,削弱了所依赖的特征探测器.

blocks.en: A natural mitigation is a front-end enhancement module that restores visibility before detection [9], but enhancement optimised for human perception does not necessarily benefit, and can actively harm, machine vision, since the two objectives are misaligned [10], [11]. Retraining the detector on augmented data is more robust but computationally expensive and impractical to repeat per degradation type on resource-constrained edge hardware such as the Jetson Nano.
blocks.zh: 自然缓解是前端增强模块,在检测前恢复能见度[9],但优化为人类感知的增强不一定有利,而且会积极伤害机器视觉,因为两个目标错位[10],[11]. 对探测器进行增强数据再培训更为有力,但在Jetson Nano等资源受限的边缘硬件上每一次降解类型重复都是费用昂贵和不切实际的。

blocks.en: Vision-based road-damage detection has moved from classical image processing toward CNN detectors, with YOLO variants now predominant [5], [15]; multi-country benchmarks such as RDD2020/2022 [16, 17] target daytime conditions, few studies address low light explicitly [18], and African contexts remain under-represented. Detector design spans two-stage detectors such as Faster R-CNN [14], one-stage detectors such as the YOLO series [4], [12], [19], and real-time transformer detectors such as RT-DETR, the first DETR-style model to outperform comparable YOLOs in speed and accuracy [13]; comparative benchmarking of these families under degradation remains sparse. Low-light enhancement has advanced from Retinex theory to deep networks such as Zero-DCE [7], EnlightenGAN [8], and the lightweight SCI network [9], but such enhancement can harm downstream detection through noise, edge blur, and colour artefacts [10], [11]. Adverse weather poses a related challenge: rain and haze are commonly modelled via the Koschmieder scattering equation [20], with physically grounded studies reporting detection drops of 25–30% under extreme rain [22]. Harmattan haze is well characterised in the atmospheric-science literature [6] but is essentially absent from the detection-robustness literature, a gap this paper begins to address.
blocks.zh: 基于愿景的道路损坏探测已从古典图像处理转向CNN探测器,YOLO的变体目前占主导地位[5],[15];多国基准,如RDD2020/2022[16,17]目标日间条件,很少研究明确涉及低光度[18],非洲的情况仍然不足。 探测器设计跨出两个阶段的探测器,例如:更快速的R-CNN [14];一个阶段的探测器,例如YOLO系列[4],[12],[19];实时变压器探测器,例如RT-DETR,这是第一个在速度和准确性上超过可比的YOLO的DETR式模型[13];对于退化下的这些家庭的比较基准仍然很少。 低光增强已经从Retinex理论发展到Zero-DCE [7],EnlightenGAN [8]等深层网络,以及轻量级SCI网络 [9],但这种增强可以通过噪音,边缘模糊,和彩色手工艺品[10],[11]来损害下游检测. 恶劣天气构成一个相关挑战:雨和雾通常通过克施米德散射方程来模拟[20],物理研究报告在极端雨下检测下降25-30%[22]。 Harmattan Haze在大气-科学文献中具有很好的特点[6],但基本上没有出现在探测-破坏文献中,本文开始处理这一空白.

blocks.en: Closest to our approach, IA-YOLO [23], GDIP-YOLO [24], and DENet/DE-YOLO [25] integrate learned, always-on enhancement end-to-end with the detector, while YOLO-DER [26] and ClassLIE [27] make a binary enhance/bypass decision after additional training; none provides a training-free, three-way routing decision with a full-bypass branch for road-anomaly detection. Benchmarks confirm lightweight YOLO variants are typically the only models approaching real-time on a Jetson Nano [28], often requiring TensorRT, quantisation, or pruning [29]; we extend these benchmarks by jointly accounting for the added cost of the enhancement front-end.
blocks.zh: 最接近于我们的方法是IA-YOLO [23],GDIP-YOLO [24],以及DENet/DE-YOLO [25] 将学习到的,总是与探测器相融合的增强端到端,而YOLO-DER [26]和ClassLIE [27] 在额外训练后作出二进制增强/通过的决定;没有一项提供无培训的,三出行道的决定,并配有一条全跨行道的分支进行道路异常检测. 基准证实,轻量级YOLO变体通常是在Jetson Nano[28]上接近实时的唯一模型,往往需要TensorRT、量化或挤压[29];我们通过共同计算增强前端的附加成本来延长这些基准。

blocks.en: This paper investigates whether front-end image enhancement can serve as a practical, real-time perception-recovery strategy for road-anomaly detection on edge-deployed vehicles. Our contributions are fourfold: a four-architecture benchmark (YOLOv8n, YOLOv12n [4],[12], RT-DETR [13], Faster R-CNN [14]) under simulated lighting/weather degradation; evidence that uniform SCI enhancement harms dusk-level detection ( − 16.1 % -16.1\% to − 30.7 % -30.7\% mAP@50); a lightweight, training-free luminance-adaptive router that recovers most of this loss; and a Jetson Nano edge-latency benchmark of the full pipeline.
blocks.zh: 本文调查了前端图像增强是否能够作为在边缘部署的车辆上进行道路异常探测的实用实时感知-恢复策略. 我们的贡献有四重:模拟照明/天气退化下的四层建筑基准(YOLOv8n、YOLOv12n [4]、[12]、RT-DETR [13]、更快的R-CNN [14];统一的SCI增强危害的黄昏级探测(−16.1%-16.1%-30.7%-30.7%-30.7%-mAP@50);轻而易举、无训练的自适应性路由器,收回了大部分损失;全管的Jetson Nano边缘纬度基准。

blocks.en: II METHODOLOGY
blocks.zh: 二. 方法

blocks.en: The overall architecture of the proposed perception-recovery pipeline is illustrated in fig. 1. Rather than forcing all images through a static enhancement front-end, the system ingests degraded frames and computes a lightweight perceptual luminance score to dynamically route the signal. Depending on this score, the frame is either bypassed entirely, passed through a moderate enhancement network, or heavily denoised and maximally enhanced before detection. This dynamic routing ensures that computational resources on constrained edge hardware are only expended when genuinely necessary to recover features.
blocks.zh: 图1说明了拟议恢复观念管道的总体结构。 1. 系统不通过静态增强前端强迫所有图像,而是吸收了已退化的帧并计算出轻量能感光分来动态地引导信号. 根据这一分数,帧要么被完全绕过,通过中度增强网络传递,要么被大量去声并被最大程度地增强后再被检测出. 这种动态路由确保了受限制边缘硬件上的计算资源只有在真正需要恢复特性时才被花掉.

blocks.en: Fig. 1: The proposed luminance-adaptive routing architecture.
blocks.zh: 发相. 1: 拟议的光能适应路由架构.

blocks.en: II-A Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: II-A 数据集建设

blocks.en: The evaluation corpus was constructed by merging two publicly available road-anomaly datasets under a targeted class-consolidation protocol: the Rajdalsaniya Pothole Detection Dataset (Kaggle, 2022; 2,077 images, single “pothole” class) [30] and the speed-unmarked-bump dataset v3 (Roboflow Universe, 2023; 2,367 images, “pothole” and “speed bump” classes, with manhole-cover variants excluded) [31]. The merged corpus comprises 4,444 images across two classes (pothole, speed bump), resized to 640 × 640 px and partitioned 70/15/15 into training, validation, and test splits. All degradation pipeline development and router threshold derivation were conducted on the 667-image validation split. The held-out 666-image test split was reserved for final confirmation of generalisability and evaluated after all methodological decisions were fixed.
blocks.zh: 建立评价套件的方法是,将两个公开可用的道路异常数据集合并在一个有针对性的类合并协议之下:Rajdalsaniya Pothole检测数据集(Kaggle, 2022;2,077个图像,单一 " pothole " 类) [30] 和速度无标记的bump数据集v3(Roboflow University, 2023;2,367个图像, " pothoole " 和 " 速度起伏 " 等类别,不包括人洞-盖变体) [31]。 合并后的主体包括两个班级的4 444个图像(孔洞、速度起伏),被调整为640×640 px,并将70/15/15分为培训、验证和测试分拆。 所有退化管道开发和路由器阈值均在667-图像验证分出时进行。 搁置的666-图像测试分拆被保留下来,以便最终确认通用性,并在确定所有方法决定之后进行评估。

blocks.zh: II-B分解管道

A physically grounded degradation pipeline was built from scratch after
preliminary trials with albumentations-based brightness-shift augmentation
caused catastrophic model collapse (YOLOv8n map@50 at dusk fell
from 0.88 to 0.056) due to unrealistic linear brightness artefacts.
Lighting degradation was simulated via gamma compression combined with
signal-dependent (Poisson-like) noise at four severity levels, calibrated to
target mean luminance values: clean ( γ = 1.0 \gamma=1.0 , no noise, mean

and severe ( γ = 4.2 \gamma=4.2 , σ = 0.110 \sigma=0.110 , plus 5-pixel horizontal motion
blur, ≈ 0.141 \approx 0.141 ), with noise variance scaling with local pixel

blocks.en: II-C Detection Architectures and Training
blocks.zh: II-C 检测架构和培训

blocks.en: Four detection architectures spanning three design paradigms were trained and evaluated under identical data splits: YOLOv8n [4] and YOLOv12n [12] (anchor-based and anchor-free, attention-enhanced one-stage CNN detectors, nano variants), RT-DETR [13] (transformer-based, end-to-end, anchor-free), and Faster R-CNN with a ResNet-50 Feature Pyramid Network backbone [14] (two-stage, region-proposal-based). YOLOv8n, YOLOv12n, and RT-DETR were trained using the Ultralytics framework; Faster R-CNN was trained using torchvision. All four models were trained on the clean (non-degraded) training split and evaluated, without retraining, on the degraded validation images, isolating the effect of test-time visual degradation and preprocessing from any domain-adaptation effect of training-time augmentation.
blocks.zh: 跨越三个设计范式的4个检测架构在相同数据分解下得到了培训和评价:YOLOv8n [4]和YOLOv12n [12](基于锁定和无锚地,可增强注意力的CNN一相探测器,纳米变体),RT-DETR [13](基于收发器,端到端,无锚地),更快速的R-CNN配有ResNet-50特有金字塔网络主干线[14](基于两相,区域建议). YOLOv8n,YOLOv12n,和RT-DETR都使用超解框架进行训练;更快的R-CNN使用火炬视觉进行训练. 所有四个模型都接受了关于清洁(非降级)培训的分解培训,并在没有再培训的情况下,对退化的验证图像进行了评估,将试验时间视觉退化和预处理的影响与培训时间增强的任何域适应效应隔离开来。

SCI was applied as a fixed, non-fine-tuned front-end preprocessor; it was not retrained or adapted to the road-anomaly domain. blocks.zh: II-E 光能路由器

blocks.en: To address the finding that uniform SCI enhancement is harmful when the input signal is already adequate, a luminance-adaptive router was developed. Perceptual luminance is computed per frame using Rec. 601 weights, adding approximately 1.2 ms of overhead on a Jetson Nano:

blocks.en: II-F Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: II-F 评价议定书

blocks.en: Detection accuracy was measured using mAP@50 (mean Average Precision at an IoU threshold of 0.50), computed separately per lighting level, per weather condition, and per router branch, and compared across three configurations: (i) baseline (no preprocessing), (ii) uniform SCI applied indiscriminately to every frame, and (iii) the proposed luminance-adaptive router. Relative degradation was additionally reported as percentage retention of clean-condition mAP@50. All evaluations used the Ultralytics evaluation loop for YOLOv8n, YOLOv12n, and RT-DETR, and a torchvision-based evaluation loop for Faster R-CNN, applied consistently across all three preprocessing configurations.
blocks.zh: 检测精度是使用mAP@50(平均精度在IoU阈值为0.50时)测量的,按灯光水平、天气条件和路由器分支分别计算,并按三种配置进行比较:(一) 基线(不进行预处理);(二) 不分青红皂白地适用于每个框架的统一SCI;和(三) 拟议灯光适应路由器。 另外,还报告相对退化为保持清洁条件mAP@50的百分比。 所有评价都使用YOLOv8n、YOLOv12n和RT-DETR的超解析评价回路,以及以火炬视为主的更快R-CNN评价回路,在所有三个预处理配置中一致应用.

blocks.en: II-G Edge Deployment Setup
blocks.zh: II-G 边际部署设置

blocks.en: Edge feasibility was assessed by deploying all four detectors, the SCI module, and the luminance-adaptive router on an NVIDIA Jetson Nano. Per-stage latency (luminance computation, enhancement, detection) and end-to-end frames-per-second (FPS) were measured for each model on each router branch, using 50 timed runs per configuration following a 10-run warm-up period that was excluded from reported statistics. This protocol isolates the fixed cost of luminance computation and SCI enhancement from the variable cost of the downstream detector backbone.
blocks.zh: 通过在NVIDIA Jetson Nano上部署所有四个探测器、SCI模块和光度适应路由器,评估了边缘的可行性。 在每个路由器分支上,每个模型的每个相位延迟(发光计算、增强、检测)和端到端帧每秒(FPS)都得到测量,在10个运行的暖化期之后,每个配置使用50个定时运行,而不计入报告的统计数据。 这个协议将发光计算和SCI增强的固定成本与下游探测器主干线的可变成本相隔离.

blocks.en: III RESULTS
blocks.zh: 三. 结果

blocks.en: III-A Baseline Robustness Under Degradation
blocks.zh: 三-A 退化下的基线强性

blocks.en: Under baseline (no-preprocessing) conditions, mAP@50 declined sharply from clean to severe lighting for all four architectures (Fig. 1), with a pronounced non-linear cliff between dusk and night. RT-DETR was the most robust, retaining 98% of clean performance at dusk and 37% at severe darkness, while Faster R-CNN retained only 28% at severe, the weakest of the four. Under weather degradation, light rain caused negligible loss (90–100% retention) and Harmattan fog produced graduated degradation (50–70% retention, RT-DETR strongest), but heavy rain caused a catastrophic collapse to 24–31% retention across all architectures (Fig. 2), substantially worse than any lighting condition. RT-DETR’s global attention mechanism consistently gave it an advantage under partial occlusion (fog, rain), whereas Faster R-CNN’s two-stage region-proposal pipeline was the most fragile across nearly every degraded condition.
blocks.zh: 在基线(无预处理)条件下,mAP@50为所有四座建筑(图1)从清洁到严重照明急剧下降,黄昏至夜间之间有明显的非线性悬崖. RT-DETR是最强的,在黄昏时保留了98%的清洁性能,在严重黑暗时保留了37%的清洁性能,而更快的R-CNN在严重时仅保留了28%的清洁性能,是四个中最弱的. 在气候退化下,小雨造成了可忽略不计的损失(90-100%保留地),而Harmattan大雾则产生分级退化(50-70%保留地,RT-DETR最强),但暴雨导致所有建筑的灾难性倒塌至24-31%保留地(图2),大大低于任何照明条件。 RT-DETR的全球关注机制在部分封存(雾、雨)下一直给予它优势,而更快的R-CNN的两阶段区域建议管道则是几乎每个退化状况中最脆弱的。

blocks.en: TABLE I: Complete mAP@50 Results. D Columns Show Delta vs Baseline
blocks.zh: 表一:完整的mAP@50成果。 D 列显示三角洲对基线

blocks.en: III-B Uniform Enhancement is Harmful at Dusk
blocks.zh: 三-B 在黄昏加强统一是有害的

blocks.en: Applying SCI uniformly caused significant mAP@50 degradation at dusk across all four architectures (Table I), ranging from -16.1% (RT-DETR) to -30.7% (Faster R-CNN). The same pass was conversely beneficial at night and severe darkness for RT-DETR and YOLOv12n, and consistently harmful for Faster R-CNN except at severe. This confirms enhancement value is condition- and architecture-dependent, not uniformly positive.
blocks.zh: SCI在黄昏时统一导致所有四个建筑的mAP@50降解(表一),从-16.1%(RT-DETR)到-30.7%(快活R-CNN)。 同样的通行证对RT-DETR和YOLOv12n来说在夜间和严重黑暗中都有利,而且除了严重外,对更快的R-CNN来说始终是有害的。 这证实增强值取决于条件和架构,而不是一致的正值。

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Baseline mAP@50 under lighting degradation.
blocks.zh: 图2:照明退化下的基线mAP@50。

blocks.en: Fig. 3: Architecture robustness: mAP@50 retention (percentage of clean baseline) across all lighting and weather conditions.
blocks.zh: 图3:建筑坚固性:在所有照明和天气条件下保留mAP@50(清洁基线的百分比)。

blocks.en: III-C Adaptive Router Recovers the Dusk Penalty
blocks.zh: 三-C 适应性路由器回收 Dusk惩罚

blocks.en: The router substantially recovered the plain-SCI dusk penalty (Table I), reducing the residual loss to 0.001–0.073 mAP@50 below baseline across both validation and held-out test splits, with RT-DETR, YOLOv12n, and YOLOv8n remaining within 0.007 of baseline dusk performance on unseen test data. At night, RT-DETR retained the strongest gain under the router (+0.045 validation, +0.071 test split), YOLOv12n showed consistent recovery (+0.036 test), while YOLOv8n and Faster R-CNN showed additional losses, the latter exceeding its plain-SCI loss and confirming the fixed thresholds are not uniformly optimal for two-stage detectors. Baseline degradation trends were consistent across splits, with absolute mAP@50 values 2–6 points lower on unseen test data as expected.
blocks.zh: 路由器大量收回了平地-SCI黄昏罚单(表一),将剩余损失降低到低于基线的0.001-0.073 mAP@50,在未发现的试验数据上,RT-DETR、YOLOv12n和YOLOv8n保持在基准黄昏性能的0.007以内。 在夜间,RT-DETR保留了路由器下最强的增益(+0.045验证,+0.071测试分出),YOLOv12n表现出了一致的恢复(+0.036测试),而YOLOv8n和更快的R-CNN则显示出了额外的损失,后者超过了其平面SCI损失并证实了固定阈值对于两级探测器来说并不是统一的最佳. 基线降解趋势在各种分化之间是一致的,在未见的测试数据上,绝对的mAP@50值低于预期的2-6分。

blocks.zh: 表二:杰特森·纳诺管线拉通. FPS 存档副本 阈值 :\ge 20 实时,\ge 15 安全最小值, < 15 < 安全以下

blocks.en: III-D Edge Deployment Throughput and Latency
blocks.zh: 三-D 边际部署

blocks.en: YOLOv8n was the only architecture approaching real-time operation (15-25.8 FPS) across all branches (Table II); YOLOv12n remained close (11.4-18.6 FPS). RT-DETR and Faster R-CNN fell well short at every branch despite stronger degradation robustness, confirming a direct accuracy-latency trade-off. SCI added a fixed overhead independent of detector (16 ms Branch B, 36 ms Branch C), making its relative cost largest for the fastest models.
blocks.zh: YOLOv8n是唯一接近实时运行的建筑(15-25.8 FPS),跨越了所有分支(表二);YOLOv12n仍然相近(11.4-18.6 FPS). RT-DETR和更快的R-CNN在每一个分支都远远不够,尽管退化强度更强,这证实了直接的准确性与相关性取舍。 SCI增加了独立于探测器(16 ms B,36 ms C)的固定起落架,使得其相对成本对于最快的模型来说最大.

blocks.en: IV DISCUSSION
blocks.zh: 四. 讨论

blocks.en: These results show that front-end enhancement is not a universally safe intervention: SCI improves detection only when the input signal is genuinely inadequate, and actively degrades it when applied to scenes, such as dusk, that already carry sufficient luminance for the detector’s feature extractor. The luminance-adaptive router demonstrates that a simple, training-free, threshold-based decision is sufficient to capture most of this effect, recovering the majority of the dusk penalty without any additional model training. RT-DETR’s consistent robustness across both lighting and weather conditions is plausibly attributable to its global self-attention mechanism, which is less reliant on local high-frequency texture than the convolutional backbones of the YOLO models and Faster R-CNN.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,前端加强不是普遍安全的措施: SCI只有在输入信号确实不足时才能改进检测,并且在应用到已经具有足够亮度的探测器特性提取器等场景时会积极降解. 光能适应路由器显示,一个简单、无训练、以门槛为基础的决定足以捕捉到大多数这种影响,在没有任何额外模式培训的情况下恢复了大部分的黄昏惩罚。 RT-DETR在照明和天气条件两方面的一贯稳健性,完全可以归因于其全球自觉机制,它比YOLO模型和更快的R-CNN的演化骨干更不依赖于当地高频纹理.

blocks.en: V CONCLUSION
blocks.zh: 五. 结论

blocks.en: This paper benchmarked four object-detection architectures for road-anomaly detection under physically grounded lighting and weather degradation and showed that uniform low-light enhancement is actively harmful at dusk, degrading mAP@50 by 16–31% across architectures. A lightweight, training-free luminance-adaptive router, selecting between no enhancement, moderate SCI, and denoising plus strong SCI based on per-frame Rec. 601 luminance, recovered 71–90% of the plain-SCI dusk penalty on the validation split and maintained dusk performance within 0.007 of baseline on the held-out test split, with RT-DETR retaining a night-level gain of +0.071 mAP@50 on unseen data. Edge validation on a Jetson Nano confirmed that only YOLOv8n, and marginally YOLOv12n, are suitable for real-time deployment at this hardware tier.
blocks.zh: 这份论文以四个物体探测结构为基准,用于在物理照明和天气退化下进行道路异常探测,并表明统一的低光增强在黄昏时是有害的,使mAP@50降低16-31%的建筑。 一种轻量级、无训练的、适应性强的路由器,在不增强、中度SCI和根据每帧Rec. 601的去诺加强SCI之间进行选择,在验证分拆上回收了71-90%的平地SCI黄昏罚,并在停放试验分拆基准后0.007内维持了黄昏的性能,RT-DETR保留了夜间收益+0.071 mAP@50。 在Jetson Nano上的边缘验证证实,只有YOLOv8n和略为YOLOv12n适合在这个硬件级别进行实时部署。

blocks.en: VI FUTURE WORKS
blocks.zh: 六. 今后的工作

blocks.en: Immediate extensions include real-world data collection under Nigerian night-time, Harmattan, and rainy-season conditions to validate the synthetic findings, and compounded degradation benchmarking combining lighting and weather simultaneously. Weather-specific restoration modules (dehazing, deraining), per-architecture threshold calibration for two-stage detectors, and model compression for sub-Jetson-Nano deployment remain open directions.
blocks.zh: 立即的扩展包括在尼日利亚夜间时间、Harmattan和雨季条件下收集真实世界的数据,以验证合成结果,以及将照明和天气同时结合起来的复合退化基准。 气象特异性的还原模块(去除,去排出),双相探测器的每层建筑阈值校正,以及子杰松-纳诺部署的模型压缩仍然开放方向.
